messages:
emily: Quick GA callout — we just promoted Streaming Toolcall v2 + mosaic-edge-3b to GA on Hosted API. :tada:

emily: What this means: stable streaming + tool-calling semantics, lower tail latency for multi-tool flows, and a new cost tier for the 3B edge model (mosaic-edge-3b).

emily: Breaking/outage risk: none for clients who use standard streaming or function/tool calling shapes. There are two notable changes you should be aware of: new response chunk header `x-rw-fragment` for out-of-band tool metadata, and a new billing unit `streaming_token_v2`.

alex: Congrats team! Quick Q — is Toolcall v2 wire compatible with v1 payloads? Any SDK changes we should expect?

emily: Short answer: yes for majority of apps. Toolcall v2 keeps the same top-level request/response contract but we added an optional `tools.metadata` envelope and the `x-rw-fragment` header in stream chunks. SDKs will add helpers for the fragments but old clients keep working. See migration notes in docs.

sam: TL;DR for customers: recommend migrating if you rely on multi-tool sessions (better ordering guarantees + lower token overhead). If you don't call tools, you should be fine to stay on v1 for now.

devrel-bot: Docs & migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/streaming-toolcall-v2-migration — includes curl + Node/Python snippets and a checklist for regression tests.

luis: Ops note: rolling canary starts now in us-west-2, then eu-west-1 in 2h, global in 12h. If any latency or error spikes >5% during canary window, page eng-oncall and pause.

ops-rotations: APM runbook updated: watch `stream.latency.p50/p95`, `tool.call.error_rate`, and the new `fragment.reassembly.failures` metric. Default alert thresholds set in the playbook.

alex: Example curl for quick smoke test (works with existing tokens):
```
curl -N -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streaming/generate?version=v2 
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-edge-3b","input":"Summarize: quarterly results","tools":[{"name":"browser.fetch","input":{"url":"https://example.com"}}]}'
```

emily: Billing: note the new `streaming_token_v2` metric — it will start appearing on invoices next billing cycle. We have a 30-day migration allowance where we will map v1 usage to historic pricing for customers who opt in; sales will reach out.

sam: Action items: devrel to update quickstarts (alex), docs owner to post migration PR (emily), eng to monitor canary (luis), and CS to prepare one-pager for customers (sam).

alex: I'll open the quickstart PR in ~15m.

luis: Canary looks clean so far (us-west-2: p95 down 8ms). Will post final go/no-go at 2123456840.

emily: Thanks everyone — posting a short announcement for external users in 30m after final go/no-go. Ping me for escalation. :rocket:
